text:
ravi: noticed a spike of SCIM errors for tenant=zenpay after the RBAC rename deploy at 11:02. KMS decrypt failures in provisioner.

elaine: sample log?

ravi: `2026-05-05T11:07:12Z ERROR provisioner.scim decrypt failed tenant=zenpay err=DecryptionFailure: encryption context mismatch (expected: role=payments_engineer, got: role=payments_eng_v2) obj=usr-42 trace=tx-f12`

security-bot: alert created: #INC-20260505-zenpay-kms-context

elaine: sounds like we include role label in KMS context. If mapping changed before rewrap, decrypts fail.

ravi: quick mitigation idea: have provisioner attempt a fallback decrypt with previous context values for 12h, gated by tenant flag. then run a rewrap job.

ops-bot: deploy request queued: patch/provisioner/fallback-decrypt -> staging.

elaine: please ensure fallback logging includes tenant and object_id and that audit events are emitted when fallback or rewrap occurs. No plaintext in logs.

sre-oncall: heads-up enabling fallback will increase KMS QPS — I'll lower KMS alert thresholds and monitor.

ravi: action list: elaine -> rewrap job plan + audit schema; elaine -> coordinate support message to ZenPay; ops -> staging deploy of fallback flag for zenpay only; sre -> monitor KMS. reconvene after dry-run. :thumbsup:
